description: Java class implementing a rule engine node for GPS geofencing events in Thingsboard, handling geofence state management, message processing, and persistence.

classes.name: TbGpsGeofencingActionNode
classes.description: A rule engine node for handling GPS geofencing events, managing geofence states, and emitting corresponding messages.

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Processes incoming messages, updates geofence state, and determines which event to emit based on geofence logic.

methods.name: switchState
methods.description: Updates the entity's geofence inside/outside state and timestamp.

methods.name: setStaid
methods.description: Marks the entity as having stayed within the geofence.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Saves the current geofence state of an entity to attributes storage.

methods.name: getConfigClazz
methods.description: Returns the configuration class type for this node.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Handles configuration upgrades from older versions.
